PM Modi to inaugurate revamped railway stations on July 17

Prime Minister Narendra Modi is scheduled to inaugurate four revamped railway stations in Karnataka on July 17. The event will also include the inauguration of a revamped railway station in Jalandhar Cantt. These inaugurations are part of a broader initiative to upgrade railway infrastructure.
